description: Free check of a UK vehicle by registration plate. Answers what car a registration belongs to, whether it is taxed and when tax is due, whether its MOT is valid and when it runs out, and whether a safety recall is outstanding. Returns the make, model, colour, fuel type and year, the MOT status and expiry date, the tax status and due date, and the recall status, with a link that opens the full free result for that registration on MotifyMe (MOT history and a free valuation). Does not include outstanding finance, insurance write-offs or stolen records, which are only in the paid vehicle history check. Rate limited.
